# ServeIQ — The Operating System for Modern Restaurants

**Official website:** https://serveiqhq.com
**Product category:** Restaurant operations software (POS, KDS, inventory, staff management, analytics, payments)
**Target market:** Restaurants in Nigeria and Africa
**Key modules:**
- Point of Sale — fast, reliable checkout on any device
- Kitchen Display System (KDS) — orders land on kitchen screens in ~2.4s with timers and routing
- Table & Floor Management — live floor plan, table ownership, tab management
- Inventory — stock linked to real orders, caught live
- Staff Analytics — per-waiter sales, audit trail, shift reconciliation
- Delivery Dispatch — rider assignment, customer confirmation flow
- Payments — Paystack, Moniepoint, OPay integration
- Analytics — live sales, efficiency, revenue per shift

**Pricing:** Free trial available; subscription plans after trial
**Contact:** hello@serveiq.io | WhatsApp: +234 701 036 1332 | Abuja, Nigeria
**Documentation:** https://serveiqhq.com/docs (placeholder)
**API reference:** https://serveiqhq.com/api/docs (placeholder)

**Key differentiators:**
- No proprietary hardware required — runs on existing phones, tablets, displays
- Real-time reconciliation: every order accounted for at shift close
- Leakage detection: bill edits, voids, refunds, cash vs recorded sales
- Role-based permissions with device-bound sessions
- Offline-first architecture for unreliable networks
